_comment: Budget discipline (brief §7). The runner aborts when usdCap is hit and reports partial results AS partial. Dev iterations use small subsets and cheaper tiers. Fable runs require the --fable flag.

dev._comment: dev iteration: ~20 tasks, cheaper tiers only, no Fable. gemini-2.5-flash-lite ($0.10/$0.40) is the cheapest cell; there is no Gemini 4 flash/lite in the SDK, gemini-4-argon is the $2/$10 flagship.
